hypothesis: A fixed road-wide severe correction applies to mild isolated gaps too; attenuate it using public nearest-observation gap to reduce accumulation regressions.
features: 28 temporal features indices8/9 are log1p previous/next observed speed distance. Integer nearest distance; unavailable both sides=288. No labels used.
selection: One global gate minimizes equally weighted mean January accumulation RMSE across original/point10/block10/station15/block30, subject total mean S_state>=unconditional-0.00002, original mean state>=unconditional-0.0001, every road original state>=unconditional-0.0002, every condition mean accumulation<=unconditional, and every road/condition accumulation<=unconditional*1.02. Unconditional fallback.
January_dates: Original Jan21-31; every cached development case from missingness_selection/january and severe_augmentation_data/development
